patterns.lesson: Cinematography must co-author the scene's dramatic approach BEFORE any interpretation is selected, under one governing audience-experience/visual-grammar decision per scene; mandatory per-shot field completion drives over-direction and conventional coverage.

patterns.proposedBy: paired evidence: v1 Scene-2 escalation + v2 Scene-2 4-shot pass
patterns.lesson: A quiet/reverent scene wants a small number of near-motionless, decisive images — coverage-as-reverence dilutes it.
Very long constraint-wall prompts degrade Seedance output (the rejected 634-word mega-prompt); the lean performance brief is the working shape.

patterns.proposedBy: checkpoint-freeze: recorded as the next source-level issue, not fixed
patterns.lesson: The v2 storyboard schema (CreativeShotCard + ProductionDetail) has no duration field of any kind — a real regression from v1's per-shot intendedDurationRange, which let a scene total be summed. This blocks reporting total scene duration and will block any future production-detail consumer (handover, previz timing) that needs it. Proposed fix: add a duration field back, most naturally to ProductionDetail (a production-layer concern per the split-contract doctrine) rather than the creative card.
